from pathlib import Path

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[]
    for rr in list(range(h-1,-1,-1))+list(range(h))+list(range(h-1,-1,-1)):
        out.append(list(reversed(g[rr]))+list(g[rr]))
    return out
